translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Luong mag rwako rieko kod mag fuwo

content.text: Rieko osegero ode,
osechungo sirnige abiriyo.
Oseiko ringe kendo oloso divai mare moru mamit,
bende osepedho mesa mare.
Oseoro jotichne ma nyiri, kendo oluongo ji
ka en kuonde motingʼore e dala maduongʼ.
“Weuru ji duto mangʼeyogi tin obi kae!”
Owacho ni jogo maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura.
Biuru, chamuru chiemba
kendo madhuru divai ma aseruwo.
Weuru yoreu maonge rieko, eka unubed mangima,
wuothuru e yor winjo kod ngʼeyo.
Ngʼat marieyo ja-ajara luongo mana wichkuot,
ngʼat makwero ngʼat marach yudo mana ayany.
Kik ikwer ngʼat ma jaro ji, nikech mano biro miyo obedo mamon kodi,
kirieyo ngʼat mariek, to obiro heri.
Puonj ngʼat mariek, to obiro bedo mariek moloyo,
puonj ngʼat makare gimoro, to obiro medo puonjore.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye e chakruok mar rieko,
to ngʼeyo Jal Maler miyo ngʼato ngʼeyo tiend wach.
Nimar kuoma ndalogi biro bedo mangʼeny,
kendo rieko biro medo hiki.
Ka iriek, riekoni nomiyi ohala,
ka ijajaro, to in iwuon ema ibiro hinyori.
Dhako mofuwo en jakoko,
ok oritore kendo ngʼeyone tin.
Obedo e dhoode,
e kom kama otingʼore mar dala maduongʼ,
koluongo jogo makadho,
madhi e yoregi.
Owacho ni jogo maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura niya,
“Weuru ji duto mangʼeyogi tin obi kae!”
Nomedo wachonegi niya, “Pi mokwal mit,
chiemo michamo apanda ema nigi ndhandhu moloyo!”
To ok gingʼeyo kata matin ni joma otho ni kuno;
bende ni joma lime ni e liel matut.
